meta.title: Condition-Based Triggering: refused for a user without the Tenant Admin role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the Tenant Admin role and verify that Condition-Based Triggering is refused or absent.
Repeat the same action as a Tenant Admin and verify that Condition-Based Triggering is available.
Determine whether tenant RBAC intentionally grants the capability to additional roles.
